PRECAUTIONS AND CONTRAINDICATIONS

Before Treatment:
• Avoid use around eyes and lips; protect eyes with wet cotton
• Use only after skin recovers from irritating treatments (e.g., peels, devices, high-concentration products)
• Stop retinoids 7–10 days before treatment (14 days for stronger prescriptions like 0.05–0.1% tretinoin)

After Treatment:
• Mild irritation may last up to 3 days
• Exfoliation may occur 2–3 days post-treatment
• Resume retinoids after 14 days post-treatment

Contraindications (Do NOT use if you have):
• Active infections
• Severe acne or rosacea
• Open wounds
• Allergies or hypersensitivity to ingredients
• Autoimmune disorders (e.g., lupus, psoriasis, eczema)
• Recent procedures (chemical peel, laser, microneedling)
• Skin cancers
• Recent sunburn or tanning
